summary: Iter 625 (Paket 28) — Branch selector propagation to Site Builder, post-payment upsell add, campaign date auto-activation window, TR/EN translation QC diff. Wrote pytest test_iter625_paket28.py — 9/9 backend tests PASS. Frontend Playwright verified all four features via admin dashboard: (a) Branch switch: site-view-link href toggles /site/default ↔ /site/aldgate-flats when branch-selector-btn → branch-aldgate-flats → branch-default is clicked; site-translations-card re-renders for the selected property. (b) Site translations card TR/EN side-by-side diff shows TR source ('Şehrin kalbinde butik konfor', about, SEO title & description), EN translation inputs populated, ✓ approve button toggles green and footer updates to '1/4 satır onaylı'; DE tab (site-tr-lang-de) present. (c) Posts editor exposes both campaign posts with correct date/promo inputs: post 0 QAWIN20 (20%, 2030-01-01→2030-02-01), post 1 QANOW10 (10%, 2026-01-01→2027-01-01). (d) Backend validated campaign→promo_code auto-activation window: QANOW10 valid (10% off £200 = £20 discount), QAWIN20 rejected as 'not yet active' (400). POST /site-builder/default with QANOW10.ends_at='2026-01-15' (past) causes /promo-codes/validate to return 400 (inactive/expired); restoring ends_at='2027-01-01' re-enables it. (e) POST /booking/AB-316679AF/add-upsell — already-added upsell 6e4f2fce returns {ok:true, already:true}; new upsell returns {ok:true, added:{price}, new_total, balance_due}; wrong guest_email → 404; unknown upsell_id → 404. GET /api/upsells/default returns 10 upsell items publicly (no auth). Site content preserved: headline 'Şehrin kalbinde butik konfor' + both campaign posts intact after tests. Booking widget /book/default post-upsell UI flow NOT re-verified end-to-end (previous iter624 covered similar flow; backend endpoint confirmed with 5 tests here).
critical_code_review_comments: site_builder.save_site: promo_codes upsert derives is_active from post.published AND (starts_at≤today≤ends_at). Correct behaviour — verified round-trip.

bookings.validate_promo_code: compares now.isoformat() (full timestamp) against valid_from/valid_until (date strings YYYY-MM-DD). Works because '2026-…' < '2030-01-01' lexicographically for future dates and inactive rows are pre-filtered by is_active=True guard. However mixing timestamp vs date strings is fragile — consider normalising both to date (YYYY-MM-DD) for clarity.
be_conversion.add_upsell: idempotent (already-added returns {ok:true, already:true}); price calc respects price_type per_night vs per_stay; updates cart_total only when present. Solid.

SiteBuilderExtras.TranslationsEditor: 'approved' state is local to component and reset on any keystroke — good UX, but not persisted server-side (approvals do not survive reload). Consider persisting per-row approval flags if audit trail is needed.
PostsEditor: no confirm on trash icon; a mis-click could delete a live campaign post. Minor UX polish.
Branch selector state (activePropertyId in App.js:254-258) now correctly propagates to SiteBuilderPanel — the prior iter624 gap is resolved.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Backend test transiently changed QANOW10 ends_at to 2026-01-15 then restored to 2027-01-01. Frontend test typed 'QA English headline' into EN translation field but did NOT click save — no persistence. Site content for 'default' preserved intact: headline 'Şehrin kalbinde butik konfor', QAWIN20 (2030 window) + QANOW10 (2026-2027 window) posts remain.
